description: This file defines an abstract class RestSerializer responsible for serializing HTTP requests based on AWS API specifications in a RESTful protocol. It includes methods for building request URIs, headers, query strings, and payloads, supporting dynamic endpoint resolution and protocol-specific behavior.

classes.name: RestSerializer
classes.description: Abstract class responsible for serializing AWS REST API requests, including URI, headers, payload, and query parameters, with support for dynamic endpoints and AWS-specific protocol features.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the serializer with API description and endpoint URI.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Serializes a command into an HTTP request, including handling endpoint resolution.

methods.name: payload
methods.description: Abstract method to serialize the payload part of the request.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes command input parameters into request options including headers, query, and body.

methods.name: applyPayload
methods.description: Prepares the payload part of the request based on command arguments.

methods.name: applyHeader
methods.description: Formats and adds a header to the request options, including special handling for timestamps, booleans, and JSON values.

methods.name: applyHeaderMap
methods.description: Adds multiple headers from a map to the request.

methods.name: applyQuery
methods.description: Adds a query parameter to the request, handling types like boolean, timestamp, and map.

methods.name: buildEndpoint
methods.description: Constructs the request URI based on operation, arguments, and endpoint.

methods.name: hasPayloadParam
methods.description: Checks if the input shape has a payload parameter.

methods.name: appendQuery
methods.description: Adds query parameters to an existing endpoint URI.

methods.name: getVarDefinitions
methods.description: Extracts URI variable definitions from operation input shape.

methods.name: normalizePath
methods.description: Ensures the endpoint path ends with a slash if appropriate.
